feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 15 May 2026 3:30am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 15 May 2026 at 3:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

There is a Strong Wind warning in operation for at first this morning.


##Synopsis##

A weak transient ridge covers the Irish Sea, with low pressures lying to the south of Greenland and south of Norway.


##Wind##

North or northwest mainly force 4 or 5, but occasionally 6 in the west of the area at first this morning, and falling variable 2 to 4 in the southwest of the area this afternoon. Then becoming northwest 3 or 4 in all waters early tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling mainly slight this afternoon, and smooth or slight tonight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, with only isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest force 3 or 4, backing south or southwest Saturday morning, and perhaps occasionally touching 5 in places during the afternoon. Then veering west or southwest 4 or 5 Saturday evening.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight Saturday afternoon, and occasionally moderate overnight into Sunday.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain and drizzle spreading from the west Saturday morning, clearing to the east overnight into Sunday to become mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor for a time in rain and drizzle.
